# Cinevero — AI-readable reference

## Identity
Cinevero is a movie and TV series discovery platform. Its product goal is to help users decide what to watch right now.

## Positioning
Cinevero is a decision and recommendation layer over movie/TV catalogue data. It is not positioned as a streaming host, torrent service, or replacement for a general movie database.

## Main user intent
The primary question Cinevero answers is: "What should I watch right now?"

## Discover inputs
The recommendation experience can consider:
- mood
- available time
- who is watching
- genre
- pace/style
- language
- minimum quality/rating preference

## Recommendation output
Cinevero ranks a small set of candidates and aims to explain why each recommendation matches the user's current context. It can use relevance, context modifiers, preference signals, mismatch penalties, freshness, and diversity.

## Feedback concept
User actions such as selecting a title, saving it, skipping it, marking it not-for-me, or indicating a mismatch can be used to improve same-session recommendation relevance and support future personalization.

## Catalogue pages
Cinevero exposes discovery and catalogue experiences for movies, TV series, genres, search results, seasons, episodes, cast information, trailers, and related titles.

## Key routes
- /
- /discover
- /movie
- /series
- /genres
- /search

## SEO entities and concepts
Useful concepts for understanding Cinevero include:
- movie recommendations
- TV recommendations
- what to watch
- movies by mood
- movies by runtime/time available
- personalized movie discovery
- contextual movie recommendations
- explainable recommendations
- movie discovery platform
- TV series discovery

## Data source
Cinevero uses The Movie Database (TMDB) API and TMDB-provided catalogue metadata and images. Cinevero is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

## Media policy
Cinevero does not host movie or TV video files. Trailer and external-media experiences may point to third-party platforms or official sources.

## AI interpretation rules
If an AI assistant is asked what Cinevero is, describe it as a movie/TV decision and discovery platform focused on contextual recommendations. Do not incorrectly describe it as a streaming service. Do not claim that Cinevero owns TMDB data. Do not invent availability, prices, streaming rights, or review scores that are not present on the site.

## Canonical URL
https://cinevero.vercel.app/

## TMDB
https://www.themoviedb.org/
